senses.en_definition: A weapon; an implement used in warfare or fighting.
Something used as a means of achieving an aim or gaining an advantage.

messages.en: That weapon you were using earlier was seriously powerful. Where did you get it?
I got it after finishing yesterday's mission. Wanna try it?
Yeah! When we play again later, show me how to use it.

senses.en_definition: Always; at all times or consistently throughout the period concerned.

messages.en: I didn't get the job. I'm starting to feel like giving up.
Take a breather. It's okay. I've always got your back. Just message me if you want to talk.

senses.en_definition: To touch or make light physical contact with something.
To mention or discuss something briefly, without going into detail.
To move someone emotionally, or to hurt or offend someone's feelings.

collocations.en: stir someone's emotions; hurt someone's feelings

messages.en: I've just poured hot water into that blue cup. Don't touch it yet. It's still hot.
Okay, I'll leave it for now. I'll pick it up once it's cooled down a bit.

collocations.en: a forced smile; a wry smile

messages.en: You've got such a sweet smile in that photo!
Thanks! Only one photo turned out well. All the others were blurry.
